review:
A mystical cat with the Future Fortunes Respin, which can follow any spin – and after each respin there's a 50% chance of another, until it fails.

Every respin lands one of four prizes for sure: two or three reels stacked with wilds, a top-symbol win, or at least two scatters. Three to five scatters give 10 to 20 free spins with a rising multiplier, and respins pick up again afterwards. 96.52% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
